missions.title: First Day at Ravenside
missions.description: It's your first day at Ravenside High. Explore the school, find the cafeteria, and get to know some of your classmates.

missions.title: Strange Rumours
missions.description: Marcus mentioned something about a 'Smile Club'. Sophie Chen in the Computer Lab might know more.

missions.title: Talk to Ava
missions.description: Oscar says Ava Thompson is always in the Library and knows more about the strange meetings under the school.

missions.title: Meet Ava in Tech Lab
missions.description: Ava Thompson asked you to meet her in the Tech Lab on Day 2 to discuss the strange meetings under the school.

missions.title: Talk to Alan Chen
missions.description: Ava Thompson says Alan Chen is usually found in discreet places. Check your map to find him.

objectives.description: Talk to Alan Chen in his discreet location

missions.title: Earn Alan's Trust
missions.description: Alan Chen won't give you the hacked information until you prove yourself. Gain at least 70 Tech Club reputation, then return to him in his discreet location.

objectives.description: Return to Alan Chen with 70 Tech Club reputation

items.name: Hacked Credentials
items.description: Hacked high school system credentials provided by Alan Chen.

missions.title: Return to Ava Thompson
missions.description: You have the hacked credentials from Alan Chen. Return to the Tech Lab and deliver them to Ava Thompson.

objectives.description: Talk to Ava Thompson in the Tech Lab

missions.title: High School Mainframe
missions.description: Ava Thompson says you can now log in to decrypt the encrypted messages. Go to the computer marked with X in the Tech Lab and extract information from the school system.

objectives.description: Log into the Ravenside High School Mainframe and find Eli's email

missions.title: Helping Mia
missions.description: Mia Nakamura is a target of cyberbullying. Help her by intercepting the harassment or standing up to her bullies.

objectives.description: Talk to Mia about what's happening

missions.title: Server Room Access
missions.description: Ava Thompson told you to gain reputation and find out who is behind the Smile Club. Go talk to Marcus Green in the Athletic Coliseum.

objectives.description: Talk to Marcus Green in the Athletic Coliseum

items.name: Basement Key
items.description: Opens the door to the school basement

missions.title: Rooftop Party
missions.description: Marcus Green invited you to the party on the Rooftop because he liked your basketball skills. Go up to the Rooftop and hang out with the populars.

missions.title: Find Ava at the Party
missions.description: You're at the Rooftop party. Find Ava Thompson and say hello.

objectives.description: Talk to Ava Thompson at the rooftop party

missions.title: Check Ava's Phone
missions.description: Ava left her phone on a chair. Something feels wrong about everyone leaving... Check her messages before she returns!

objectives.description: Read Ava's group chat with Marcus and Noah

missions.title: Final Showdown
missions.description: This is it. Enter the Basement and explore the labyrinth to find the Smile Club.
